# One synthetic feedback-consumption occurrence

These are safe artifacts of one actual agent drafting turn and two independent draft reviews. They contain no real owner action or private original. case.json binds the recorded source event/version and original page hash; draft.md separates interpretation and application. review.json records actual content/Standards judgments against draft.html at candidate b2fdbe9. The draft's earlier pending-review sentence is preserved chronology; review.json supplies the later judgment. occurrence.json records the retained local Git demonstration and its actual exact retries.

Replay with `uv run pytest -q tests/test_page_feedback_consumption.py` from the project root. Initial replay:9 passed in1.90s; the retained original-case regeneration/two retries took0.734s. Drafting took99.53s; independent review elapsed was not separately instrumented. Those external judgments are not rerun by replay.

The replay makes another disposable synthetic repository, supplies a generated private canary and the same case/date/event, reproduces the safe version1 blob, appends application evidence, regenerates changed content and retries the original event. It checks the recorded draft/review integrity and this example's declared evidence-strength criterion. Eight planted gaps cover rating-only storage, missing/wrong citations, absent disposition, unchanged defect, stale review binding and pending review. This bounded check is not a general semantic judge or evidence of RSI benefit, real-site consumption, campaign qualification or owner QA. The raw original remains only in private recovery; no private host paths or raw prompts are exported.

The original review record remains in its retained private commit. A fifth local
commit exports safe reviewer role aliases; occurrence.json binds that export.
Only identity formatting changes: judgments, source version and draft bytes are
identical. FAIL292/293 retains the public hygiene refusal before this correction.
